records.text: Owens accused Eric Bolling of lying on the PBD Podcast to promote a narrative that she and Charlie Kirk had not spoken in years
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Eric Bolling thing drives me insane still to this day that he lied so much and said I hadn't spoken to Charlie since 2019.

And a guy named Eric Bolling is just lying through his teeth on PBD, the PBD podcast, to establish this narrative which, for some reason, every major publication is now running with: that I haven't spoken to Charlie (Charlie Kirk) in years.

verification.notes: Re-reviewed the source-scoped context and searched current reporting. The retrieved announcement repeats Owens's allegation. It does not establish Bolling knowingly lied or intended to promote a false narrative. The older PBD source could not be fetched in this review. Prior mixed/high improperly treated occurrence of the disputed comments as verification of the accusation about intent.

records.text: Candace Owens has not been at a Turning Point event in many years
records.speaker: Eric Bolling

appearances.snippet: When's the last time she was at a Turning Point event? Not in many years.

verification.notes: Directly contradicted by contemporaneous records. Turning Point USA announced Candace Owens as a participant in its Spring 2024 Live Free Tour, and event reporting documents her speaking for more than an hour at the TPUSA tour stop at UNC-Chapel Hill on March 6, 2024. That appearance was about eighteen months before the September 2025 quoted claim, not many years earlier.

records.speaker: Eric Bolling

appearances.snippet: There's a... they're even involved. There's a—no question—proof that Candace (Candace Owens) is nothing... has nothing to do... she would be—in a perfect world, if they didn't have this, what I already know was a very quiet breakup, where she got too rabbit-hole for him

verification.notes: Eric Bolling made the claim on the September 17, 2025 PBD Podcast, but public evidence does not establish the asserted private 'quiet breakup' or its alleged cause. Owens later explicitly denied any falling out, while TPUSA's own 2024 materials show continued professional collaboration and a joint campus-tour roster. Those facts complicate the claim but do not directly prove or disprove a private relationship change, and no conclusive statement from Kirk or contemporaneous private record was found.
